name: disable_selected_object_view_culling

stack.evidence: func_001D5378 reads only the selected object pointer at Script offset 0x04 and does not access the value stack

notes: func_001D5378 sets object flag 0x2000000000000 through func_00135760. The model visibility path bypasses its transformed-bounds frustum test while this flag is set, forcing the object through the render path; the engine's embedded operation name for this state is VIEW_OFF. The adjacent func_00135738 clears the flag. The JP corpus contains 11 calls during scripted-object setup; six entries also disable background collision and five also disable object collision.
